apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: canvas-create-admin
  namespace: canvas
spec:
  backoffLimit: 1
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: create-admin
        image: instructure/canvas-lms:stable
        command: ["bundle", "exec", "rails", "runner"]
        args:
        - |
          account = Account.default
          account ||= Account.create!\(name: "LTI Testing"\)
          user = User.create!\(name: "Admin"\)
          user.accept_terms
          user.register!
          ps = user.pseudonyms.create!\(unique_id: "admin@gmac.io", password: "admin123Admin!", password_confirmation: "admin123Admin!", account: account\)
          role = Role.find_by\(name: "AccountAdmin"\)
          account.account_users.create!\(user: user, role: role\)
          puts "SUCCESS: Admin user created"
        env:
        - name: RAILS_ENV
          value: "production"
        - name: CANVAS_DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: canvas-postgres-secret
              key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/src/app/config/database.yml
          subPath: database.yml
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/src/app/config/cache_store.yml
          subPath: cache_store.yml
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/src/app/config/redis.yml
          subPath: redis.yml
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/src/app/config/domain.yml
          subPath: domain.yml
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/src/app/config/security.yml
          subPath: security.yml
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/src/app/config/outgoing_mail.yml
          subPath: outgoing_mail.yml
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/src/app/config/dynamic_settings.yml
          subPath: dynamic_settings.yml
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "1Gi"
          limits:
            memory: "2Gi"
      volumes:
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: canvas-config
EOF)

Bash(/dev/null <<'EOF'
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: canvas-gen-token
  namespace: canvas
spec:
  backoffLimit: 1
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: gen-token
        image: instructure/canvas-lms:stable
        command: ["bundle", "exec", "rails", "runner"]
        args:
        - |
          user = User.find\(1\)
          token = user.access_tokens.create!\(purpose: "seed_script"\)
          puts "TOKEN:#{token.full_token}"
        env:
        - name: RAILS_ENV
          value: "production"
        - name: CANVAS_DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
